ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Eroding Sanity: His magnetic powers slowly sap Neal Emerson’s Awareness and Will. He is also susceptible to telepathy powers. Magnetic: Doctor Polaris is basically a living magnet, and as such he functions like one, losing his “charge” when exposed to extreme heat, recharging with kinetic energy, susceptible to magnetic fields, etc. Split Personality: Doctor Polaris is a second personality within Neal Emerson. Both personalities wrestle for control.
